source_refs.note: Exercise 3.3, Question 21: book p. 89-90, 24 questions (integration by parts); answer key p. 301 (printed under 'Exercise 3.5')

blocks.explanation:
Write \(\csc^3 x = \csc x\cdot\csc^2 x\); \(\csc^2 x\) is easy to integrate.
Plan: parts with \(\csc x\) first; use \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\); the original integral returns, so solve for \(I\).
steps:
Given: \(I = \int \csc^3 x\,dx\).
To find: the indefinite integral.
Method: integration by parts with \(f = \csc x\), \(g = \csc^2 x\); then \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\) and solve for \(I\).

Integration by parts
\[I = \int \csc x\cdot\csc^2 x\,dx\]
\[= \csc x(-\cot x) - \int (-\cot x)(-\csc x\cot x)\,dx\]
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc x\cot^2 x\,dx\]
Why: \(\int \csc^2 x\,dx = -\cot x\), \(\frac{d}{dx}\csc x = -\csc x\cot x\).

Use \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\)
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc x(\csc^2 x - 1)\,dx\]
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc^3 x\,dx + \int \csc x\,dx\]
Why: \(1 + \cot^2 x = \csc^2 x\).

Solve for \(I\)
\[I = -\csc x\cot x - I + \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\]
\[2I = -\csc x\cot x + \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\]
\[I = -\dfrac{1}{2}\csc x\cot x + \dfrac{1}{2}\ln|\csc x - \cot x| + c\]
Why: \(\int \csc x\,dx = \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\); bring \(-I\) to the left.

Check
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(-\csc x\cot x) = 2\csc^3 x - \csc x\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\ln|\csc x - \cot x| = \csc x\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(2\csc^3 x - \csc x) + \tfrac{1}{2}\csc x = \csc^3 x\]
Why: \(\csc x\cot^2 x + \csc^3 x = 2\csc^3 x - \csc x\).
